name: fancy
description: One render pipeline for Claude's replies: themed markdown, inline color tags, status badges and color swatches; plus a responsive status bar (who, model, context, plan limits, git) and terminal tab colors by session state

markdown.title: Styled markdown
markdown.description: Draw replies with fancy's markdown engine. Off hands the markdown to the plugins beneath and the engine; badges and color swatches still draw. /fancy on|off overrides it.

theme.title: Markdown theme
theme.description: The palette and layout replies draw in. native keeps fences and tables in the engine's own renderer. /fancy <theme> overrides it.

teachMarkup.title: Teach the model color tags
teachMarkup.description: Adds a system prompt section that teaches the model the inline <t> tags. Off removes it, saving its prompt tokens every session, whatever /fancy teach says.

tags.title: Tags and colors
tags.description: Comma-separated TAG:color pairs. A color is a hex, a theme key or a color name; hex stops joined by > paint a gradient. Empty uses the defaults.

style.title: Style
style.description: badge draws the tag on a colored background; text draws it as colored bold text

text_color.title: Badge text color
text_color.description: auto picks white or black per badge, whichever has the higher WCAG contrast with a hex background; theme keys keep the theme's inverse text

showIdentity.title: Show identity
showIdentity.description: Who runs the session, from the TIAMATI_AGENT environment variable, drawn first in the status bar. Unset draws nothing.

identityColors.title: Identity colors
identityColors.description: Comma-separated name:color pairs for the identity, a hex or a color name. Empty uses the defaults; a name without a color draws in the accent color.

showModel.title: Show model
showModel.description: The model in use, as /model names it.

showContext.title: Show context
showContext.description: How full the context is, measured against where the session compacts (CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE), not the whole window.

showBranch.title: Show branch
showBranch.description: The current branch, or the short SHA on a detached HEAD.

showDiff.title: Show diff
showDiff.description: Lines added and removed against the merge base with the default branch, uncommitted work included.

showPullRequest.title: Show pull request
showPullRequest.description: The number and state (Merged, Closed, Draft or Open) of the branch's pull request, linked to it. Needs the GitHub CLI.

showChecks.title: Show CI checks
showChecks.description: Passed checks out of the total for the branch's pull request. Needs the GitHub CLI.

showUsage.title: Show plan limits
showUsage.description: The plan's 5-hour and weekly limits with the time to their reset; amber when the pace so far would run out before the reset, red past 90%.

iconBranch.title: Branch icon
iconBranch.description: Drawn before the branch name. Empty draws none; a Nerd Font glyph goes here. Spaces count.

iconDiff.title: Diff icon
iconDiff.description: Drawn before the added and removed lines. Leave it empty for no icon. Spaces count.

iconPullRequest.title: Pull request icon
iconPullRequest.description: Drawn before the pull request number. Empty draws none; a Nerd Font glyph goes here. Spaces count.

iconChecksPassed.title: CI passed icon
iconChecksPassed.description: Drawn before the checks when every one passed. Empty draws ✓, none draws no icon.

iconChecksFailed.title: CI failed icon
iconChecksFailed.description: Drawn before the checks when any failed. Empty draws ✗, none draws no icon.

iconChecksPending.title: CI running icon
iconChecksPending.description: Drawn before the checks while some still run. Empty draws ◌, none draws no icon.
